classify_triangles_by_texture: classify mesh triangles into groups based on which texture region colors they sample
reduce_mesh_by_faces: reduce a mesh to only the faces and vertices selected by a boolean mask
reduce_mesh_by_vertices: reduce a mesh to only the vertices and faces selected by a boolean mask
split_mesh_by_texture_region: split a mesh along texture color boundaries to extract geometry for a specific region
create_mesh_with_texcoords: create a Mesh object with vertices, faces, texcoords, and texcoord_faces arrays
